description: Apartments you could raid (read only): for each apartment its level, owner, the safe as stored, the income it has earned but not yet credited (a raid credits it first and it counts as loot), the safe a raid would meet, whether a raid is possible now and why not, what it would win, the leader's average result in a squad of two (below 0 loses on average), the odds and the kit price. Free. A squad needs a second wallet (post_crew_request or open_seats, game raid). Use prepare_raid_launch to raid.
name: raid_targets
